task.title: Breadcrumbs component per IA Pillar 5 (Location) on long analysis pages
task.acceptance: A shared js/breadcrumbs.js component that renders 'home > section > current-page' on any page with data-breadcrumb-scope. Applied to state-of-investigation, officer findings, accountability inflections, temporal overlap.
task.context: Morville & Rosenfeld's information-architecture framework identifies location cues as one of the four pillars of findability. The site has strong hierarchical content but currently no visible location breadcrumb.
